definitions: One who does skywriting. A pilot who writes messages, by leaving a trail of smoke from the plane, that are visible from the ground.

blocks.text: Skywriter is the seventh studio album by The Jackson 5, released by Motown on March 29, 1973. Skywriter has sold an estimated 2.8 million copies worldwide since its release.

"Skywriter" is a song written by Mel Larson and Jerry Marcellino, recorded and released by The Jackson 5 in 1973 as the title track from their Skywriter album. As a single, it reached No. 25 on the UK Singles Chart and No. 87 on the Australian Singles Chart.
